changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' AND TABLE_NAME = 'AssetVersion') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [metrics].[AssetVersion] ( [AssetUid] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [EffectiveDate] [date] NOT NULL, [Weight] [decimal](5, 3) NOT NULL, [ConditionAndOr] [varchar](1) NULL, [CreatedOn] [datetime] NULL, [CreatedBy] [int] NULL, [EffectiveEndDate] [date] NULL, [State] [int] NULL, [Uid] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [Name] [nvarchar](250) NOT NULL, [Description] [nvarchar](4000) NULL, [Threshold] [float] NULL, [UpdateFrequency] [int] NOT NULL, [MatchConditionsOnly] [bit] NOT NULL, [Definition] [nvarchar](4000) NOT NULL ) END

changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.rollback:
if exists (select * from [sys].[default_constraints] where [type] = 'D' and name = 'DF_MetricAssetVersion_Uid') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[AssetVersion] DROP CONSTRAINT [DF_MetricAssetVersion_Uid] end
if exists (select * from [sys].[default_constraints] where [type] = 'D' and name = 'DF_MetricAssetVersion_Name') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[AssetVersion] DROP CONSTRAINT [DF_MetricAssetVersion_Name] end
if exists (select * from [sys].[default_constraints] where [type] = 'D' and name = 'DF_MetricAssetVersion_UpdateFrequency') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[AssetVersion] DROP CONSTRAINT [DF_MetricAssetVersion_UpdateFrequency] end
if exists (select * from [sys].[default_constraints] where [type] = 'D' and name = 'DF_MetricAssetVersion_MatchConditionsOnly') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[AssetVersion] DROP CONSTRAINT [DF_MetricAssetVersion_MatchConditionsOnly] end
if exists (select * from [sys].[default_constraints] where [type] = 'D' and name = 'DF_MetricAssetVersion_Definition') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[AssetVersion] DROP CONSTRAINT [DF_MetricAssetVersion_Definition] end
if exists (select 1 from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[REFERENTIAL_CONSTRAINTS] where constraint_name = 'FK_MetricAssetVersion_MetricAsset') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[AssetVersion] DROP CONSTRAINT [FK_MetricAssetVersion_MetricAsset] end
if exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[TABLE_CONSTRAINTS] where CONSTRAINT_TYPE = 'UNIQUE' and CONSTRAINT_NAME = 'UQ_MetricsAssetVersion') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[AssetVersion] DROP CONSTRAINT UQ_MetricsAssetVersion WITH ( ONLINE = OFF ); end
if exists (select 1 from [sys].[key_constraints] where name = 'PK_MetricAssetVersion') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[AssetVersion] DROP CONSTRAINT PK_MetricAssetVersion WITH ( ONLINE = OFF ) end

changeSet.sql: if not exists (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'CIX_MetricsAssetVersion') begin CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX [CIX_MetricsAssetVersion] ON [metrics].[AssetVersion] ( [AssetUid] ASC, [EffectiveDate] ASC ) end
